data.title: 埃塔 · 雾化实验的衣物错位
data.description: 雾化重组实验刚结束，埃塔的史莱姆战服在重组时出了点小差错——衣料错位地贴在身上，半透明的史莱姆还在缓缓流动。她面无表情地低头检查，在记录板上写下：“副作用：羞耻。建议忽略。”
data.location: 阴影庭园地下实验室·实验场
data.action: 低头检查错位的半透明史莱姆衣，手持记录板，表情平淡
data.lighting: purple glow of the mist formation circle
data.promptProse: After the atomization trial, adult Eta calmly inspects her misaligned, half-translucent slime clothes, clipboard in hand, noting the side effect in a flat, sleepy tone.
data.animaCaption: 'Side effect: embarrassment. Recommendation: ignore.' Eta writes it down and reaches for her coffee.
